singleJudge.finding: [states] The URL field the error sentence names ('Enter the URL of the source.') is not drawn invalid. Its whole 1 px edge reads the focusBorder colour (0,120,212) on every side, and no inputValidation.errorBorder pixel appears around it, so only the sentence below shows the error state, not the field. The colour-role table (§4, Text field: invalid = inputValidation.errorBorder, token --nuiget-color-input-error-border) asks for the error border on an invalid field.

The cause is the -1 px focus outline painting over the aria-invalid error border. No hard measurement in ui-output.txt covers the field's border colour, and the main-installed-details spec does not declare this difference.

singleJudge.reason: A consequence of ruled (f): the focus ring on the focused invalid URL field covers its error border, as DS-FOCUS-3 rules; every hard focus line of the cell is green and the error is still said by the glyph, the sentence, aria-invalid and aria-describedby.
